subject: Security: Request for IR runbook + sanitized post-incident dossier
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@regmedpartners.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: incident-response@regmedpartners.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IR runbook + sanitized dossier for recent auth anomaly

Hi Sofia / Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick action on last week's authentication anomaly. Our security team at RegMed has asked for a formal handoff package so we can complete our internal SIG / SOC 2 mapping. Specifically we need:

- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) runbook (redacted where necessary)
- A sanitized post-incident dossier summarizing the event, timeline, root cause analysis, and remediation steps
- Any telemetry extracts and sample logs we can use for our audit team (sanitized)

I've attached our standard evidence request form (regmed_ir_request_form.pdf) — it lists redaction constraints and what our auditors need. Can you confirm an estimated turnaround and the expected format for the dossier? We are aiming to close our audit portal by Nov 10.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of InfoSec
RegMed Partners

Attachment: regmed_ir_request_form.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@regmedpartners.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR runbook + sanitized dossier for recent auth anomaly

Tom — thanks for the note and the form. We're able to provide a sanitized IRP extract and a redacted post-incident dossier. High level plan:

1) Confirm redaction scope (PII / tenant-specific identifiers) with you (see questions below).
2) Generate a sanitized timeline and remediation summary (PDF).
3) Provide sample telemetry extracts (CSV) and a short README describing fields and limitations.

Questions from our side:
- For the dossier, do your auditors require verbatim logs or are parsed/aggregated samples acceptable?
- Are there specific CIDs/tenant IDs that must be redacted beyond standard PII?

Proposed timeline: preliminary package by 2026-11-03, final after your review by 2026-11-06. If you need Nov 10 hard deadline, we can prioritize but will need confirmation on redaction scope today or tomorrow.

I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate the artifact compilation and redaction review.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@regmedpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR runbook + sanitized dossier for recent auth anomaly

All — pulling together the deliverables. Draft scope for the package (we propose):

- Redacted IRP extract (publicly shareable procedures; internal contact info replaced with roles)
- Sanitized incident timeline (UTC timestamps, aggregated session counts; unique tokens redacted)
- Root cause and remediation summary (non-technical executive summary + technical appendix with sanitized traces)
- Telemetry samples: 3 CSV extracts (auth_attempts_sample.csv, token_kv_sample.csv, error_trace_sample.csv)
- README: how samples were generated and redaction checklist

Redaction approach: replace tenant ids with stable pseudonyms (e.g., REGMED-001), hash user identifiers, and remove stack traces that contain third-party customer values. We'll run a manual review before delivery.

Attachments to include in initial package: regmed_ir_request_form.pdf (your form), and a short redaction checklist (we will attach when ready).

If auditors need verbatim logs for forensic reasons, we will require a separate narrow-scope access window and an NDA addendum (we can escalate).

—Marissa
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (will include redaction_checklist.txt in package)

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@regmedpartners.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: incident-response@regmedpartners.com, Carolyn Reed <carolyn@regmedpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR runbook + sanitized dossier for recent auth anomaly

Thanks Marissa — that scope looks fine. A couple clarifications:

- Aggregated samples are fine for SOC 2, but our external auditors will request verbatim logs if they cannot validate the sanitized traces. We'll flag that as potential follow-up.
- RegMed would prefer stable pseudonyms (REGMED-###) in the artifacts.
- For the access window: if you need to provide verbatim logs later, please send the access plan and we'll route through our procurement team; DocuSign is preferred for the addendum.

I've uploaded the evidence request and created a HubSpot ticket: HP-48291 — please reference that in the final package. I can accept the initial package by Nov 3; if you can meet Nov 6 for final that would be excellent.

DocuSign link (for addendum if needed): https://docusign.com/placeholder/abcd1234
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/record/HP-48291

Best,
Tom

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@regmedpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-31T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR runbook + sanitized dossier for recent auth anomaly

Tom — confirming plan and delivery.

We will:
- Deliver a preliminary package by 2026-11-03 (redacted IRP extract, sanitized incident dossier, README, and three CSV samples).
- Include the HubSpot ticket id HP-48291 in metadata.
- Use stable pseudonyms as requested.

Attached: redacted_ir_summary_regmed_20261031.pdf (preliminary dossier). This is a sanitized executive + technical appendix; please review and send redaction concerns by 2026-11-02 to allow finalization.

If your auditors require verbatim logs we will prepare an access plan and DocuSign addendum and route through your procurement contact.

Let's schedule a short handoff call tomorrow 10/31 at 16:00 PT to walk through the dossier (I've invited Jonas for any architecture questions).

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_ir_summary_regmed_20261031.pdf
